project.name: Rain's Flexible Modules — World Utils
project.description: Moving between worlds and dimensions (/w, /dim — names and selectors), and making, resetting and deleting worlds with a chosen seed and a history of every seed a world has had. The hard parts — regenerating a group of worlds without stranding anybody, carrying game rules across, the seed history, portal linking and who may enter a world — are RainsCore's; this module is the commands, the worlds it made, and where each player last stood in each world.
